# ADR-012 — Typography

Status: accepted (Tope, 21 Nov 2026).

## Decision

Target-language text uses **SIL Andika**, already bundled at `assets/google_fonts/Andika-*.ttf` and declared as the `Andika` family. Body and uncovered letters use **Noto Sans** (`LingAfriqText`) plus the bundled Noto faces for Arabic, Ethiopic, N'Ko, Tifinagh, Adlam, Vai, Osmanya, and Bamum. Display type stays **Nunito** (`LingAfriqDisplay`).

Andika is the literacy face from the design source. Nunito is the display face already shipping in the app. Noto covers the scripts Andika does not.

## Glyph string

`Ẹ kú àárọ̀ · Ọ̀ ṣun · Ị́ bịa · ɓaƙo ɗan ƴaƴa · Ɛyɛ · ŋ ɲ ɔ̃ · ሰላም · ߒߞߏ · ⵜⴰⵎⴰⵣⵉⵖⵜ`

Andika draws the Latin and tone-mark run. Noto Sans Ethiopic, N'Ko, and Tifinagh draw `ሰላም`, `ߒߞߏ`, and `ⵜⴰⵎⴰⵣⵉⵖⵜ`. The test is `test/design/font_coverage_test.dart`.

## Licence

Andika, Nunito, Noto Sans, and the Noto script faces used here are SIL Open Font License 1.1. They may be bundled in the app. `configureBundledFonts()` sets `GoogleFonts.config.allowRuntimeFetching = false`, so those faces are read from assets.

Dosis stays declared because existing screens still reference that family. It is not the target-language face and it is not fetched at runtime.
